description: Check a set of Hiring Signals filters against the contract and return the exact request: method, URL with its query string, headers, a `curl` command (bash, zsh), the same request for PowerShell, and the `jobo signals` command. Pass `company_id` for one company's endpoint. The commands read the key from the `JOBO_API_KEY` environment variable. It does not send the request: no network call, no key, no cost. Sending it is billed per signal returned, at ten times the price of a job, and `limit` is the most one call can bill. An unknown filter, a value outside a fixed vocabulary, a list value with a comma, more than 100 values, a number out of range, a date in the wrong shape or a filter the per-company endpoint does not take is reported, and no request is built.

categories.description: Company categories, as returned in company.categories, e.g. SaaS. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

company_id.description: One Jobo company id (a GUID): the request then reads `GET /api/companies/{id}/signals`, which takes only types, min_strength, detected_after, detected_before, created_after. Look the id up with `find_companies`.

company_ids.description: Only signals at these companies, by Jobo company id (a GUID). At most 100. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

company_sizes.description: Headcount bands of the companies. One of: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, 10001+. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

countries.description: Countries the companies are headquartered in, as two-letter codes, e.g. "US", "DE". An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

created_after.description: Only signals first stored after this instant, exclusive. To read what is new, pass the newest created_at already received. ISO 8601 with seconds, e.g. 2026-11-12T09:30:00Z.

cursor.description: The previous page's `next_cursor`, unchanged, with the same filters.

detected_after.description: Earliest detection day, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd.

detected_before.description: Latest detection day, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd.

domains.description: Only signals at these companies, by website domain, e.g. "stripe.com". At most 100. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

exclude_agencies.description: Leave out staffing agencies, whose postings are their clients' hiring. Not taken with `company_id`.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out these companies, by website domain, e.g. your existing customers. At most 100. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

founded_after.description: Only companies founded in this year or later. 1800 to 2100. Not taken with `company_id`.

functions.description: Job categories the signal must be about, e.g. "Technology", "Sales". A focus filter. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

funding_stages.description: Latest funding round of the companies, as returned in company.funding_stage, e.g. "Seed", "Series A". An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

industries.description: Industries of the companies, matched against the primary industry and the industry list. A value cannot contain a comma. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

job_cities.description: Cities the jobs are in, e.g. "Austin". A focus filter; only new_city and hard_to_fill record a city. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

job_countries.description: Countries the jobs are in (not the company's headquarters), as two-letter codes. A focus filter. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

job_regions.description: States, provinces or regions the jobs are in, e.g. "Texas". A focus filter. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

limit.description: Signals per page, 1–200 (API default 50). The most the request can bill: every signal returned is billed.

min_days_open.description: Only hard_to_fill signals for jobs open at least this many days. Other types are not affected. 1 to 365. Not taken with `company_id`.

min_new_jobs.description: Only hiring_surge and function_surge signals of at least this many new jobs. Other types are not affected. 1 to 10000. Not taken with `company_id`.

min_strength.description: Only signals at least this strong. Strength runs from 1 to 100 and compares signals of the same type. 1 to 100.

reposted_only.description: Only hard_to_fill signals for jobs posted again after closing. Other types are not affected. Not taken with `company_id`.

roles.description: Words or phrases to look for in the job title or occupation behind the signal, e.g. "data engineer". At least 2 characters each. A focus filter. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

seniority.description: Seniority of the role behind the signal. A focus filter. One of: junior, mid, senior, director, vp, c_level, executive. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

skills.description: Named skills the signal must be about. A focus filter, combined with technologies. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

technologies.description: Named tools the signal must be about, e.g. "Snowflake". A focus filter, combined with skills and technology categories. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

technology_categories.description: Every tool in a category, as returned in details.technology_category, e.g. "CRM". A focus filter. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values. Not taken with `company_id`.

types.description: Only these kinds of signal, e.g. hiring_surge, new_country, leadership_hire. Leave empty for every kind. One of: hiring_surge, new_function, new_country, leadership_hire, new_skill, hiring_slowdown, first_role, new_technology, function_surge, new_city, hard_to_fill, leadership_role_closed, hiring_freeze, hiring_resumed. An array; no value may contain a comma; at most 100 values.
